title: Drop leftover copy pins, helper echo, and extra regression tests
author: cursor

body:
## Intent Keep the test suites added after #2447 honest: every remaining assertion should have an independent oracle and could still fail if a live path regresses. ## Why Daily leftover pass after #2557–#2595. Agents left instructional-copy pins, glob-constructor echo, husky file-content pins, and extra cases that only restate a path already covered. Those helped while verifying; they are not worth keeping. ## Summary - DELETE `agent-guidance.node.test.ts` — catalog + docs-nav already cover the new guide; capability/instruction `toContain('guide:agent_guidance')` was instructional-copy pinning. - COMBINE webhookSyntheticDispatch request/params/reject-caller cases; keep secret-vs-redacted `url_secret` absence. - COMBINE synthetic dispatch request+params and reject paths; DELETE the extra “burns automation usage” case (same `dispatchWebhookInvocation` call as the happy path). - DELETE extra empty/`Mailchimp`/`grant/mailchimp` `PackageNameInputError` inventory cases (the class is already asserted on the live mismatch/invalid leaves). - DELETE startup-bundle name inventory and husky hook file-content pins; keep positive-integer budget + invalid-ceiling reject, and the real docs-vs-code hook workflows. - EDIT wrangler allowlist expects to live generated module names + no-wildcard/stray check instead of `expectedEsModuleGlobs()` echo; un-export the unused glob constructors. - DELETE control-kody usage-line pin and the extra 401-without-cookie-file case (stale-cookie refresh already flips that state). KEEP: KODY-82 D1_ERROR-prefixed DO reset drop/retry, KODY-83 PackageNameInputError off Sentry, control-kody POST-first login and public `/pricing` without `/auth`, git-hook docs-only skip + rename still typechecks, webhook minted/mode/owner/payload/persist-delivered oracles. ## Testing - `npm run format` before commit; pre-commit oxfmt/oxlint + typecheck + migrations:check - Targeted: 8 node-unit files (28 tests) - `test:push` on push: node-unit 1070 files / 3506 tests; workers-unit 98 files / 378 tests ## System changes Test-only plus un-export of unused glob helpers. No production behavior change. Risk: low.
System recap — composes existing primitives (low risk) **Mode:** recap · **Base:** `main` @ `bd31f2be` · **Head:** `91a6c14f` **Classification:** composes — no primitives added or changed; this PR only deletes or rewrites leftover tests. ### Primitives touched | Primitive | Group | Impact | | --- | --- | --- | | `webhooks` | assistant | composes — combine synthetic dispatch workflows, drop extra usage-helper case | | `saved-packages` | assistant | composes — drop extra PackageNameInputError inventory cases | ### Change flow Leftover tests from yesterday's main commits are deleted or rewritten so remaining asserts have an independent oracle. ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Reviewer participant webhooks as webhooks participant savedPackages as saved-packages Reviewer->>webhooks: drop extra usage-helper case and combine fixture/reject workflows Reviewer->>savedPackages: drop extra PackageNameInputError inventory cases ```
  
--- > [!NOTE] > **Low Risk** > Test-only deletions and refactors with un-export of unused allowlist helpers; no runtime code paths change. > > **Overview** > This PR **trims leftover regression tests** so remaining assertions stand on their own rather than echoing copy, file contents, or paths already covered elsewhere. **No production behavior changes**—only test rewrites and removal of unused `expectedEsModuleGlobs` / `expectedCompiledWasmGlobs` helpers from `worker-additional-module-allowlist.ts`. > > **Worker / webhooks:** Deletes the `agent-guidance` catalog/docs-nav/instruction pinning file. Merges `webhookSyntheticDispatch` and `dispatchSyntheticWebhookForUser` cases into fewer tests while keeping oracles for synthetic metadata, `url`/`url_secret` redaction, fixture stamping, minted/mode/owner/payload rejection, and caller-context guards. Drops redundant package-name `PackageNameInputError` inventory cases. > > **Tooling tests:** Combines startup bundle budget checks (drops fixed worker-name list). Drops control-kody usage-string and duplicate 401-without-cookie coverage. Narrows `isDocsOnlyHookPath` examples and removes Husky hook file-content pins. Wrangler allowlist tests now assert each known generated module appears in globs and wildcards/stray modules are absent, instead of matching a constructed glob list exactly. > > Reviewed by [Cursor Bugbot](https://cursor.com/bugbot) for commit 91a6c14f2655353820ae11fdc3f4ba0d7613234a.
